K1.definition: Does the object intrinsically take three arguments?
K1.name: Arity match

K2.definition: Are its arguments naturally vectors, tangent vectors, representation vectors, or Lie-algebra elements?
K2.name: Vector-like domain match

K3.definition: Is the object canonically or naturally defined once the relevant mathematical structure is specified?
K3.name: Canonicality

K4.definition: Is the ternary object preserved by a nontrivial symmetry group?
K4.name: Invariance

K5.definition: Does it encode geometry rather than being an arbitrary user-defined function?
K5.name: Geometric content

K6.definition: Is there a precise relation to an ordinary bilinear metric or invariant bilinear form?
K6.name: Metric relation

K7.definition: Is the object intrinsically associated with E8 rather than connected through a discretionary chain of analogies?
K7.name: Direct E8 relevance
